name: Emanation (Anger)
scaffolding_intent: Emits anger particles around an entity and shifts its tint toward red, showing that it is angry or frustrated

parameters.name: tint
parameters.description: RGB tint shift applied to entity pixels (additive)

parameters.name: tintSaturation
parameters.description: How strongly the tint is applied (0 = no tint, 1 = full tint)

correction_intent: Child attributed a wrong emotion to a character the scene shows angry, frustrated, or irritated (clenched fists, red face, furrowed brows, shouting, stomping). Target that character. Not for fear; that is P2f.
suggestion_intent: A character is visibly angry, frustrated, or irritated (clenched fists, red face, furrowed brows, shouting) and the child has not said so. Target that character. Requires a visible cue of anger.
